title: text message data
description: Plain or Markdown text (chativa DefaultTextMessage, mekik TextMessageData). Chips travel in the frame-level `actions` field, not inside data (the chativa parseChatFrame rule).

text.description: At most limits.maxTextBytes (64 KiB) of UTF-8.

attachments.description: Legacy Converger activity attachments, carried verbatim for activities created through the pre-v1 API. New senders use image/file/video/audio messages.
